request.subject: math
request.question: A rectangle has length 8 cm and width 5 cm. Find its area and perimeter.
request.reference_answer: Area = length x width = 8 x 5 = 40 cm^2. Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x 13 = 26 cm.
